# Sunshine State Junk Removal & Dumpster Rental

Family- and veteran-owned junk removal and dump-trailer rental company operating from two locations — Coral Springs (original and primary) and Southwest Ranches — serving Broward County, Florida, with select service in Miami-Dade and Palm Beach Counties.

## Business snapshot
- Name: Sunshine State Junk Removal & Dumpster Rental
- Owners: Cesar Hurtado (U.S. military veteran) and Lynzee Hurtado
- Rating: 5.0 stars across 159+ Google reviews
- Positioning: family-owned, veteran-owned, licensed & insured, transparent volume-based pricing, same-day availability, 24/7 for urgent jobs
- Phone / SMS: (954) 247-1399
- Email: info@sunshineremoval.com
- Website: https://www.sunshineremoval.com
- Discounts: military, veterans, seniors, first responders

## Locations
- Coral Springs (original & primary location): 3700 NW 104th Ave, Coral Springs, FL 33065 — Phone: (954) 247-1399 — Hours: Open 24/7 — https://www.sunshineremoval.com/locations/coral-springs/
- Southwest Ranches (second location): 5011 SW 210 Terrace, Southwest Ranches, FL 33332 — Phone: (305) 326-2436 — Hours: Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM — https://www.sunshineremoval.com/locations/southwest-ranches/

## Services
- Junk Removal — full-service pickup and hauling of household clutter, furniture, appliances, mattresses, yard debris, construction and renovation debris, hot tubs, sheds, and general bulky items.
- Dump Trailer Rentals — driveway-safe 18-yard and 21-yard dump trailers for renovation, cleanout, roofing, and yard-work projects. Delivery and pickup included.
- Cleanouts — garage, estate, storage-unit, property-management, tenant/eviction, hoarder-house, foreclosure.
- Construction Debris Removal — drywall, cabinets, flooring, scrap wood.
- Commercial — office cleanouts, shelving, retail, warehouse.
- Specialty — hot tubs, sheds (light demo), refrigerators, mattresses.

## Not accepted
Hazardous or restricted materials: chemicals, paints, propane tanks, pool chemicals, used oil, batteries, pesticides, asbestos, and biohazard waste. Bed bug–infested furniture and scrap can be handled with special disposal — always disclosed before work begins.

## How to get a quote (fastest)
Text a few clear photos of the items to (954) 247-1399. We reply quickly with a straightforward, all-inclusive price. Photo quotes work for most household, garage, and cleanout jobs. Prefer to call? (954) 247-1399, 24/7.

## Pricing — junk removal (18-yard dump trailer, labor and disposal included)
- Minimum load: $99
- 1/4 load: $295
- 1/2 load: $495
- 3/4 load: $695
- Full load: $895
Notes: Construction Debris rates are subject to change for the amount of labor and disposal fees required. An additional surcharge may apply for stairs, long-distance hauling, bagging items, or item disassembly.

## Pricing — dump trailer rentals (flat rate)
- 18 Yard Dump Trailer — $495 flat rate (includes 7 days and the first 2 tons)
- 21 Yard Dump Trailer — $525 flat rate (includes 7 days and the first 2 tons)
Notes: A 14-day rental period is available for all containers for an additional $125 added to the base rate, if requested at the time of booking. Dump & Return service is charged as a new rental at the full flat rate for your trailer size ($495 for the 18 yard, $525 for the 21 yard). Rentals that extend beyond the 14th day will accrue a $25 per day fee beginning on the 15th day after delivery. Weight over the included tonnage is charged by weight at a rate of $120 per ton.

## Dumpster rental service area
Serving all of Broward and Palm Beach Counties. Miami-Dade available by appointment only — restrictions apply.

## Not accepted in dumpsters
The following items are not accepted in our dumpsters. If any of these materials are found in the bin, the load will be returned to your job site and a $100 surcharge will apply:
- Appliances containing refrigerant (air conditioners, refrigerators, freezers)
- Tires and batteries
- Paint and paint cans
- Propane tanks
- Ammunition
- Hazardous materials

Currency: USD. No hidden fees — pricing is public at https://www.sunshineremoval.com/pricing/.
